_comment: THE RULE STAGE'S TRIGGER TABLE for 2002 into 2023 (lineage_screen.py, kb/Work PB5589; DESIGN-spec-conformance-review.md
section 10.5). `triggers`: each cause that bars a candidate pair from a KEPT record written by rule, by mechanism (the
only code), its parameters, the field or text it reads and the reason an excluded pair is listed with; a null
mechanism is a named empty slot, and no batch is written while one exists. `pending`: the judgment of each changed or
removed pending clause (its 2023 counterpart where the title match is wrong, the 2002 clauses it governs, the patterns
that invoke it, why). `behaviours`: the 2002 clauses of each compiler dialect behaviour that changed after 2002.
`holds`: rows held by evidence no text shows (the S1 run's refusals of a construct the rule names).

triggers.name: target-state
triggers.reason: the 2023 rule it pairs with is not CONFORMS and OK, so no verdict carries

triggers.name: target-band
triggers.reason: the 2023 rule's band does not name 2002, so the chain places no test at 2002

triggers.name: ambiguous
triggers.reason: the rule pairs with more than one 2023 rule

triggers.name: normalized
triggers.reason: the texts are the same only after typography is erased

triggers.name: absent-from-2014
triggers.reason: the rule's words are not in the 2014 text the KEPT record bridges

triggers.name: definition-changed
triggers.reason: the rule uses a term whose 2023 definition differs from 2002's

triggers.name: definition-dropped
triggers.reason: the rule uses a term 2002 defines and 2023's definitions clause does not (its meaning rests on where 2023 now defines it)

triggers.name: cross-reference
triggers.reason: the rule refers to another clause by number, whose content may differ

triggers.name: pending-clause
triggers.reason: the rule depends on a pending clause whose text changed or is gone in 2023

triggers.name: behaviour-switch
triggers.reason: the rule's clause holds a behaviour the compiler switches between 2002 and 2023

triggers.name: held
triggers.reason: the rule is held by evidence no text shows

triggers.name: band-formats
triggers.reason: the formats the rule's band rules differ between the two editions (2023 split or joined the formats)

triggers.name: clause-identity
triggers.reason: the rule's clause is not the same set of rows in both editions (a row added, removed, unpaired or moved)
triggers.why-measured: PLAN-2002-v3-K0 section 1: it bars 83 of the sample's 84 SAME pairs, so it is scored, never a refusal

triggers.name: communication-reach

params.context: the 2002 communication section (Annex A, the CD entry)
params.confined: (?:only|shall be specified only) in the (?:file|working-storage|local-storage|linkage|report|screen) section

triggers.source: §2002:A (the communication facility; §2002:G.2 item 1, obsolete) and the 2002 catalog's FMT-13.14 rows
triggers.reason: the rule governs entries a 2002 CD entry can hold, the communication section 2023 removed, so its 2002 scope is wider

triggers.name: removed-element
triggers.source: §2002:G.2 items 1-3 (communication facility; debugging lines and DEBUGGING MODE; PADDING CHARACTER), §2002:G.1 item 4 (ON OVERFLOW of CALL)
triggers.reason: the rule names an element 2002 marks obsolete or archaic that a later edition removed

triggers.name: deferral
triggers.reason: the rule defers to other rules, whose content it does not state
